newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes lower as cash gains recede.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes lower as cash gains recede.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower on a weaker cash market with direction for the market sought from the export sector, traders said.
"Cash markets did not surge over the weekend and that may have set us back a little," a trader said.
There were signals Friday the benchmark Thai market was weakening. Rice futures last week rallied to a series of contract highs on firm cash markets and active exports.
Traders said the market was eyeing results of several export tenders.
Iraq is seeking 30,000 tonnes of rice and Colombia is in the market for 35,000 to 50,000 tonnes of rice.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 350 contracts, below the 848 traded Friday.
Rice futures closed three to 14 cents per cwt lower, with March down 14 at $12.18-1/2 per cwt.
